hazards.description: The intersection ahead lacks high-visibility markings, increasing the risk of vehicle-pedestrian conflicts.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at potential crossing points to reduce the unprotected crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add high-visibility continental-style crosswalk markings to clearly designate pedestrian crossing areas.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming Measures
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or cushions to physically slow traffic to safer residential speeds.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised median or refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide street in two stages.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve sight lines.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Reconstruction
interventions.description: Replace damaged concrete panels to create a level, continuous, and ADA-compliant walking surface.

interventions.title: Vegetation Maintenance
interventions.description: Clear weeds and prune overhanging branches to restore the full width of the pedestrian path and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting to improve visibility and personal security for pedestrians after dark.

interventions.title: Speed Cushions
interventions.description: Implement traffic calming to ensure vehicle speeds remain appropriate for a residential area.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Planting street trees in the furniture zone would provide a vertical buffer and naturally slow traffic through psychological narrowing of the street.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Mid-Block Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a marked crossing with high-visibility paint and signage to provide a safer, designated crossing point for residents.

interventions.title: High-visibility midblock crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with high-visibility paint to provide a designated crossing point for residents.

interventions.title: Curb extensions (bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at potential crossing points to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Speed humps or cushions
interventions.description: Implement vertical deflection measures to reduce vehicle speeds in this residential area.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crosswalk
interventions.description: Implement a high-visibility marked crosswalk with 'Yield to Pedestrian' signage to formalize crossing in this residential area.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffers
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or street trees between the sidewalk and the curb to provide a physical and psychological buffer from traffic.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks and Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install high-visibility marked crosswalks with curb extensions (bulb-outs) to reduce crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Installing street lights would improve visibility and safety for pedestrians during nighttime hours.

interventions.title: Mid-block Pedestrian Refuge
interventions.description: Given the width of the street, a central refuge island would allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Marked Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility crosswalk to provide a designated and safer crossing point for residents.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Reconstruction and Curb Installation
interventions.description: Install a raised concrete curb and a properly paved sidewalk to provide physical separation and a level walking surface.

interventions.title: Street Lighting
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve safety and visibility during nighttime hours.

interventions.title: Mid-block Pedestrian Crossing
interventions.description: If pedestrian demand is high, install a marked mid-block crossing with high-visibility markings and appropriate signage.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Implement traffic calming measures like speed humps to reduce vehicle speeds in this residential environment.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Repair cracked pavement and implement a maintenance program to remove invasive vegetation from the walkway.

interventions.title: Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Trim overgrown trees and bushes that encroach on the public right-of-way to improve sightlines.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to the existing traffic signal infrastructure.
